purpose: Teach: 賑わっ/戸惑う/祝っ/釣っ/ありえ/よくよく/ふっと/にわか

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、文化祭、賑わってたな
lines.en: The cultural festival was really crowded, wasn't it?
lines.style: Bright observation, slightly lilting upward. Quick and present. The tone of someone noticing something good happened and wanting to mark it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、新クラスで戸惑うことあるか?桜
lines.en: Do you ever feel out of place in your new class?
lines.style: Gentle probe, not pushing. Softer attack than his usual cool. A question he's actually wondering about, not performing curiosity.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の合格をお祝ってやるぜ
lines.en: I'm seriously proud of you for getting in.
lines.style: Direct and unguarded for once. Quick on the attack—no room for him to deflect with humor. Warm but steady, like she means every word.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、お父さんと魚を釣ったろ?桜
lines.en: Did you go fishing with your dad?
lines.style: Casual check-in. Soft, almost sideways—not demanding an answer, just asking because he noticed something about her. Comfortable silence underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のスコア、ありえないぜ
lines.en: Your test scores are absolutely ridiculous.
lines.style: Playful admiration with a slight tease underneath. Animated but not over-the-top. The voice of someone impressed and not hiding it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、よくよく漢字、覚えてるな、桜
lines.en: You've really got a solid memory for kanji.
lines.style: Quieter than it sounds on paper. A genuine compliment, not flashy. Observant—he noticed what others might have missed.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、ふっと小学校のこと思い出したぜ
lines.en: I just had this random flash of elementary school.
lines.style: Thoughtful, a little surprised by the memory itself. Softer pace. The gentle nostalgia of someone looking back at younger versions of themselves.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、にわか雨で濡れたな、桜
lines.en: You got soaked in that sudden downpour, remember?
lines.style: Dry, affectionate half-smile in the voice. He's teasing but it's the kind that means he was there and he remembers. Light, warm underneath.
